newsitem.title: USA: Republic to buy Value Rent-A-Car.
newsitem.headline: Republic to buy Value Rent-A-Car.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Monday it had agreed to acquire Value Rent-A-Car from Mitsubishi Motor Sales of America for $77.5 million.
The purchase price will be payable at Republic's option in cash or Republic common shares.

In connection with the acquisition, Republic and the Mitsubishi Motors Corp affiliate will enter into vehicle supply agreements which will provide Value and Republic's other rental vehicle operations -- Alamo, National and Spirit -- the opportunity to use up to 27,000 vehicles per year, Republic said.
Value Rent-A-Car operates 45 locations in six states.
In connection with the transaction, Republic will enter into long-term lease agreements covering the related real estate.
The closing of the acquisition is subject to customary conditions, including receipt of all necessary governmental approvals, Republic said.
